scope: static-budget acceptance/overhead and at most one fixed8 exploratory run; no primary comparison
overhead_caveat: Two healthy 4s controls per executable in ABBA order, identical client bytes, build mode/config/affinity and 80/s workload. This checks gross regressions, not equivalence proof or saturated-capacity overhead. Direct event timers omit some telemetry/locking costs and include descheduling; ranges are not confidence intervals.

comparison.caveat: One historical fixed32 and one new fixed8 run; shared gate healthy-load overhead checked separately, but source version/time/host noise and admitted cohorts are confounded. Skips are outcomes, not exclusions; local residence is not end-to-end latency.
